findings.highlight: There’s no hesitation in those attacks.
findings.evidenceJa: そこに間断はなく
findings.governingReading: There is no interruption or interval between them.
findings.explanation: Continuous attack tempo becomes the fighters’ lack of psychological hesitation.

findings.highlight: breaks through Archer’s defense each time it is thrust.
findings.evidenceJa: 回を増すごとにアーチャーの守りを崩す。
findings.governingReading: With every repetition the lance breaks down Archer’s defense further.
findings.explanation: Progressive erosion across exchanges becomes a completed breakthrough on every thrust.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァント中最速の英霊
findings.governingReading: the Heroic Spirit fastest among the Servants
findings.explanation: A class-bounded speed judgment becomes an unrestricted ranking of all Heroic Spirits.

findings.highlight: A strained voice escapes Archer’s mouth.
findings.evidenceJa: 二度、アーチャーから苦悶が漏れる。
findings.governingReading: A second sound of agony escapes Archer.
findings.explanation: The recurrence and explicit agony disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 得物を振るう腕の動き、その足捌きさえ
findings.governingReading: even the arm wielding his weapon and the work of his feet
findings.explanation: The exact bodily components of Lancer’s acceleration collapse into generic movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 全身に傷を負い死に至る
findings.governingReading: suffering wounds across his whole body and dying from them
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents slowness and loses the source’s whole-body accumulation of injury.

findings.highlight: another thirty ways to “show an opening”
findings.evidenceJa: 三十通りは“隙を見せる”事ができる。
findings.governingReading: can devise at least thirty ways to show an opening
findings.explanation: “Another” invents thirty additional methods beyond an unstated prior set.

findings.evidenceJa: 修練によって得られる鉄の心
findings.governingReading: the iron mind or heart acquired through training
findings.explanation: A trained cognitive discipline is replaced by a generic courage idiom.

findings.evidenceJa: 凡人故の武器だった。
findings.governingReading: it was a weapon born precisely of being an ordinary man
findings.explanation: The thematic link between Archer’s technique and his ordinariness disappears.

findings.highlight: Lancer backs off and stops for a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: 槍を翻し、わずか、ランサーは足を止めた。
findings.governingReading: Lancer turns his spear and pauses his feet for only a moment.
findings.explanation: A momentary halt within engagement becomes a retreat.

findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と鼻で笑う。
findings.governingReading: He gives a derisive snort through his nose.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s dismissive snort becomes generic laughter.

findings.highlight: aimed at the neck to chop his head off.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔ごと吹き飛ばすつもりで首を狙った。
findings.governingReading: aimed for the neck intending to blow away the face with it
findings.explanation: The violent intended result changes from blasting away Archer’s face to decapitation.

findings.highlight: aimed at the heart to destroy his body.
findings.evidenceJa: 肋ごと粉砕するつもりで心臓を払った。
findings.governingReading: swept at the heart intending to smash it together with the ribs
findings.explanation: Exact anatomy and the sweeping attack become generic bodily destruction.

findings.highlight: How does one know that this sort of fight is serious?
findings.evidenceJa: このような戦闘で本気になったところで何がある。
findings.governingReading: What would it amount to even if he fought seriously in a battle like this?
findings.explanation: A rhetorical dismissal of seriousness without Noble Phantasms becomes a question about recognizing seriousness.

findings.evidenceJa: チッ。まったく、本気かオレは！
findings.governingReading: Tch. Seriously—what am I doing?
findings.explanation: Lancer’s annoyed self-reproach for being influenced by Rin’s thanks becomes an outward-sounding challenge or disbelief.

findings.highlight: would’ve had no trouble with Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターになぞ後れはとるまい
findings.governingReading: would surely not have fallen behind Caster
findings.explanation: Lancer’s assessment that the pair could keep pace becomes an easier claim that Caster would pose no trouble.

findings.highlight: the path that has the highest possibility of victory
findings.evidenceJa: 少しでも勝算の高い手段
findings.governingReading: the means with even slightly better odds of success
findings.explanation: Archer’s incremental optimization becomes a claim that he selected the globally best plan.

findings.highlight: Your tactics will get you through many battles.
findings.evidenceJa: せいぜい上手く立ち回るだろう。
findings.governingReading: at best, you will maneuver skillfully
findings.explanation: The limit and contempt in Lancer’s concession are replaced by an unsupported record across many battles.

findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上る闘気。
findings.governingReading: Fighting spirit rises from him.
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an aural roar to the visual image of mounting battle aura.

findings.highlight: Fortunately, I do not have any pride.
findings.evidenceJa: あいにく誇りなどない身だからな。
findings.governingReading: Unfortunately for you, I am a man without such pride.
findings.explanation: The polarity is reversed, changing Archer’s barbed dismissal into satisfaction at lacking pride.

findings.evidenceJa: 余分なプライド
findings.governingReading: superfluous pride
findings.explanation: Archer calls heroic pride excess baggage, not inherently meaningless.

findings.evidenceJa: オレの槍の能力
findings.governingReading: the ability of my spear
findings.explanation: The English supplies the Noble Phantasm’s name before Lancer speaks it in the staged release.

findings.highlight: immerses himself in his own mind.
findings.evidenceJa: 自己の裡に埋没する。
findings.governingReading: submerges into the depths of his own self
findings.explanation: Archer’s inward metaphysical concentration is narrowed to ordinary thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 生半可な物では済まされまい
findings.governingReading: nothing half-measured or inadequate will suffice
findings.explanation: The required defensive strength becomes an odd claim about superficiality.

findings.highlight: Even his after-image is a blur.
findings.evidenceJa: 残像さえ遙か
findings.governingReading: even his afterimage is left far behind
findings.explanation: The image of Lancer outrunning even his afterimage becomes ordinary motion blur.

findings.highlight: always pierce the heart once it is thrust
findings.evidenceJa: 放てば必ず心臓を貫く
findings.governingReading: will invariably pierce the heart when released or thrown
findings.explanation: The defining thrown release is mistranslated as a thrust immediately before the text distinguishes the two attacks.

findings.evidenceJa: ぎしり、と空間が軋みをあげる。
findings.governingReading: Space gives a creaking groan.
findings.explanation: A concrete aural strain in space becomes silent geometric distortion.

findings.evidenceJa: 死翔の槍
findings.governingReading: The two-stage written name is “Piercing Death-Flight Spear,” read “Gae Bolg.”
findings.explanation: mirror moon keeps only the ruby pronunciation and drops the written name distinguishing this release from Lancer’s other Noble Phantasm use.

findings.highlight: The lance of causality joins with the words to form a tapestry of action.
findings.evidenceJa: 紡がれる言葉に因果の槍が呼応する。
findings.governingReading: The lance of causality answers the words being spun.
findings.explanation: An unsupported “tapestry of action” replaces the lance’s direct response to the incantation.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔弾が迫る。
findings.governingReading: The magical projectile closes in.
findings.explanation: The supernatural projectile is reduced to an ordinary bullet.

findings.highlight: each layer is as strong as a castle wall.
findings.evidenceJa: 一枚一枚は古の城壁に匹敵する。
findings.governingReading: each petal rivals an ancient city wall
findings.explanation: Ancient fortification scale and the petal unit become a generic castle-wall comparison.

findings.highlight: The demonic lance reaches the seventh layer that has never been broken.
findings.evidenceJa: なおその勢いを緩めない。
findings.governingReading: The lance reaches the reputedly unpierced seventh layer without losing momentum.
findings.explanation: The decisive fact that six layers have not slowed the lance disappears.

findings.highlight: The unstoppable thorn of the demonic lance.
findings.evidenceJa: 殺しきれぬ魔槍の一棘。
findings.governingReading: the demonic lance’s thorn that has not managed to finish killing him
findings.explanation: A description of the attack failing to complete the kill becomes a claim of unstoppable force.

findings.evidenceJa: 想像を絶する頭痛
findings.governingReading: a headache beyond imagination
findings.explanation: The extraordinary scale and specific headache are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 強い疑問
findings.governingReading: powerful doubt and suspicion
findings.explanation: Lancer’s identity-threatening suspicion becomes neutral or admiring wonder.

findings.highlight: There is no such hero on this planet.
findings.evidenceJa: この世のどこを探しても見あたるまい。
findings.governingReading: No such hero could be found anywhere in this world.
findings.explanation: The mythic “this world” register becomes the modern physical planet.

findings.evidenceJa: 戯れ言を。
findings.governingReading: Nonsense.
findings.explanation: Unsupported modern profanity coarsens Lancer’s terse rejection.

findings.evidenceJa: そうじゃねえかとは思ったけどな。
findings.governingReading: I suspected that might be the case.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s prior suspicion is promoted into certain knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦々しげに言って
findings.governingReading: Saying it bitterly
findings.explanation: Lancer’s bitterness toward Archer disappears at the duel’s anticlimactic end.

findings.evidenceJa: 主の下に帰ろうと踵を返し
findings.governingReading: turns on his heel intending to return to his Master
findings.explanation: The stated destination and loyalty motive disappear before Lancer decides to remain.

findings.evidenceJa: もうしばらくだけ様子を見よう
findings.governingReading: to watch how things go for just a little longer
findings.explanation: The limited extension that qualifies Lancer’s lingering concern disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 草むらに体を預けていた。
findings.governingReading: rests his body in the grass
findings.explanation: The intransitive action is rendered with the transitive verb “lays.”
